product_metadata.title: Wilton Butterflies Cupcake Decorating Kit, Cupcake Decorating Supplies
features: In order to cut down on extra packaging waste, each individual item in your set will arrive together in a plain brown box
Show off your decorating skills by creating beautiful butterfly cupcakes with everything in this set

Includes these Wilton products: 75 sweet dots cupcake liners, 4 jars of pastel icing colors, 12-piece cupcake decorating kit, 24 colorful butterfly icing decorations and 1 bottle of bright daisy sprinkles
Standard yellow cupcake liners with assorted color dots
Gel-based pastel icing colors: Creamy Peach, Cornflower Blue, Petal Pink and Moss Green, 0.5 oz. each. Made in a facility that also processes tree nuts, egg and soy products
description: You know there’s more than one way to catch a butterfly, and it’s with something sweet. Start with cupcakes in these colorful dotted liners, then use pastel icing colors to tint your frosting in flowery colors. Fill disposable decorating bags with tinted frosting and use the 1M, 4B and 2D tips to create pretty blossoms for the royal icing butterfly decorations to perch. Sprinkle a few bright daisy-shaped sprinkles around the edges, sit back and enjoy the garden of treats you’ve created. In order to help cut down on extra packaging waste, each individual product in your activity bundle will arrive together in the same plain brown box.
